newsitem.title: USA: Chartwell Leisure files 4.5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell Leisure files 4.5 mln shr offer.

text.p: Chartwell Leisure Inc said on Friday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 4.5 million shares of common stock, par value $.01 per share.
Chartwell Leisure said it has 9.5 million shares of common stock outstanding.
The company said it plans to offer the underwriters an option to buy an additional 675,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
Chartwell Leisure intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the shares to repay a portion of its outstanding indebtedness under its credit facility.
Morgan Stanley, Bear Stearns, Montgomery Securities and Chase Securities will co-manage the underwriting group.
